Attached: 1 image

Because I want to add words of a book, I decided to further improve the tagging UI in my vocabulary learning tool Xiaolong Dictionary. When typing a new tag name to add to existing tags of a set of words, now some tag names which contain the user input text are shown next to the entry widget[1]. They are clickable labels. When one clicks them they are added to the list of tags for the set of words.

(New are the blue tag names.)
